#include "recomp_funcs.h"
#include <emmintrin.h>
/* These four original CVTPI2PS instructions have MEMORY operands, not MMX
registers. Preserve the high XMM qword, x87/TOP/tag state, and use MXCSR
rounding. SSE2 converts zero in its unused lanes (no extra FP exceptions). */
static RecompXmm driving_cvtpi2ps_mem196(RecompXmm dst, uint32_t va) {
__m128i integers = _mm_set_epi32(0, 0, (int32_t)MEM32(va+4), (int32_t)MEM32(va));
__m128 converted = _mm_cvtepi32_ps(integers);
RecompXmm out; _mm_storeu_ps(out.f, converted);
dst.u[0] = out.u[0]; dst.u[1] = out.u[1]; return dst;
/* PAL 1462B3 PUSHAD: saved ESP is the pre-PUSHAD value. */
{ uint32_t original_esp = esp;
PUSH32(esp, eax); PUSH32(esp, ecx); PUSH32(esp, edx); PUSH32(esp, ebx);
PUSH32(esp, original_esp); PUSH32(esp, ebp); PUSH32(esp, esi); PUSH32(esp, edi); }
xmm6 = driving_cvtpi2ps_mem196(xmm6, 0x1da518);
xmm5 = driving_cvtpi2ps_mem196(xmm5, 0x1da528);
xmm6 = driving_cvtpi2ps_mem196(xmm6, 0x1da510);
xmm5 = driving_cvtpi2ps_mem196(xmm5, 0x1da520);
{ __m128 v = _mm_loadu_ps(xmm6.f); v = _mm_cvtsi32_ss(v, (int32_t)ebx); _mm_storeu_ps(xmm6.f, v); } /* PAL 146475 CVTSI2SS */
POP32(esp, ebp); g_ebp = ebp; g_seh_ebp = ebp; /* publish restored register */
/* PAL 1464AE POPAD skips its saved ESP slot. */
POP32(esp, edi); POP32(esp, esi); POP32(esp, ebp);
esp += 4; POP32(esp, ebx); POP32(esp, edx); POP32(esp, ecx); POP32(esp, eax);
g_ebp = g_seh_ebp = ebp;
POP32(esp, ebp); g_ebp = ebp; g_seh_ebp = ebp; /* publish restored register */ /* leave */
